requirements.requirement: The system must extend the provider schema to include a field named new_patient_acceptance.
The system must constrain new_patient_acceptance values to exactly one of: yes, no, or unknown.
The system must include a source_attribution field associated with new_patient_acceptance indicating the origin of the data.
The system must include a last_verified timestamp field for new_patient_acceptance in ISO 8601 format.
The system must define a normalization contract that maps raw ingestion values to the standardized set (yes/no/unknown).
The system must default new_patient_acceptance to unknown when no source data is provided.
The system must reject any ingestion record where new_patient_acceptance contains a value outside the allowed enumeration.
The system must require source_attribution to be non-empty when new_patient_acceptance is yes or no.
The system must allow source_attribution to be null or empty only when new_patient_acceptance is unknown.
The system must validate that last_verified is not a future timestamp.
The system must define deterministic mapping rules such that identical raw inputs always produce the same normalized new_patient_acceptance value.
The system must log a normalization warning when raw input values cannot be confidently mapped and are set to unknown.
The system must ensure backward compatibility by not breaking existing provider schema fields during extension.
The system must document the schema contract including field definitions, allowed values, and normalization rules in a machine-readable format.
The system must handle ingestion records with conflicting acceptance signals by assigning new_patient_acceptance to unknown.
